newsitem.title: USA: SFX in marketing pact with American Radio.
newsitem.headline: SFX in marketing pact with American Radio.

text.p: SFX Broadcasting Inc said Monday it had signed a local market agreement with American Radio Systems Corp.
Under the agreement, SFX will program and sell advertising on WRFX-FM in Carlotte, N.C., before the closing of SFX's previously announced station swap with American Radio, SFX said.
SFX has agreed to acquire WRFX-FM in exchange for WDSY-FM in Pittsburgh and $20 million.
SFX currently has two Charlotte stations, WLYT-FM and WTDR-FM.

SFX said that with completion of the station swap with American Radio and other previously announced transactions, it will own and operate 72 stations in 20 markets and will own or operate through leases or have exclusive contracts with 20 concert venues in five states.
